tools.name: net_pay
tools.description: South Korea take-home pay for an employee: monthly net salary after national pension, health and long-term care insurance, employment insurance, and withheld income tax (2026 NTS simplified withholding table) plus local income tax.

tools.name: social_insurance
tools.description: South Korea four major social insurances (national pension, health, long-term care, employment) for a monthly wage: employee deductions and employer contributions at 2026 rates.

tools.name: severance_pay
tools.description: South Korea statutory severance pay (toejikgeum): 30 days of average wage per year of service, with retirement income tax, from hire date, last working day and last 3 months of pay.

tools.name: retirement_income_tax
tools.description: South Korea retirement income tax on a severance payment: service-year deduction, converted-pay deduction, national and local tax, and the reduced tax if received as an IRP pension.

tools.name: annual_leave
tools.description: South Korea paid annual leave under the Labor Standards Act: days currently available, remaining days, next accrual, and payout value of unused leave.

tools.name: unemployment_benefit
tools.description: South Korea unemployment benefit (job-seeking allowance, silup geupyeo): daily amount with 2026 cap and floor, number of benefit days, and total.

tools.name: parental_leave_benefit
tools.description: South Korea parental leave benefit from employment insurance, month by month with caps, including the 6+6 both-parents scheme and single parents.
